exam.title: SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite is published. Snowflake recommends two or more years of hands-on data-engineering experience in production. Be ready to source governed lake/API/on-premises data, build deterministic batch and near-real-time transformations, replicate/share across clouds, isolate and scale compute, and operate quality/freshness/performance/cost/recovery evidence.

review.notes: All five live public abilities are mapped through production contracts, state/checkpoints, reconciliation, idempotency/replay, backpressure, SLOs and observable performance/cost/recovery evidence. Candidates are told to reconcile the form-delivered detailed guide; inaccessible weights are not invented. Three scenarios, eight labs and 40 checks are included. Eight URLs are reachable and two O'Reilly books are automation-blocked; none are broken. No recalled item, dump or copied course content is used.

findings.title: Current streaming has distinct channel contracts
findings.evidence: September15ElasticGA requires documentedSDK1.8.0API and introduces server-managed multiproducer ingestion.
findings.recommendation: Add current channel comparison with explicit version verification.
findings.resolution: Add current channel comparison with explicit version verification.

findings.title: Durable acknowledgement precedes row processing and queryability
findings.evidence: Elasticack follows durable buffering;atleastonce retry can duplicate;appendtokens correlate rather than deduplicate.
findings.recommendation: Separate retained input,ack,errors,visible rows and business reconciliation.
findings.resolution: Separate retained input,ack,errors,visible rows and business reconciliation.

findings.title: Source offsets require client recovery coordination
findings.evidence: Opaque tokens track commits but do not prevent producer resends;ordering is channel-local and inactive offsets expire.
findings.recommendation: Require replayable input,stablechannelidentity and applicationinterpreted restart;do notclaim universal automatic exactlyonce.
findings.resolution: Require replayable input,stablechannelidentity and applicationinterpreted restart;do notclaim universal automatic exactlyonce.

findings.title: New partitioned streaming support has ownership and architecture exclusions
findings.recommendation: State exact target boundary and verify actual account/client.
findings.resolution: State exact target boundary and verify actual account/client.

findings.title: A default event table does not prove telemetry collection
findings.evidence: September24release requires schemaLOG_EVENT_LEVELINFO or inheritance plusreadaccess.
findings.recommendation: Teach collection/access/visibility checks without configuring logging or alerts.
findings.resolution: Teach collection/access/visibility checks without configuring logging or alerts.

findings.title: Task graph recovery is not one atomic transaction
findings.evidence: Root suspension leaves runninggraph;calledprocedure canchange;skippedroot nofinalizer;overlapandretry distinct.
findings.recommendation: Teach graph/dependencyversioning and sideeffect-aware retries;add concrete proposed failurelab.
findings.resolution: Teach graph/dependencyversioning and sideeffect-aware retries;add concrete proposed failurelab.

findings.title: Independently replicated checkpoints can duplicate or lose work
findings.evidence: Stream/source/destination alignment and upstreamretention required;externalstage files/trust separate;promotedoffset canlag.
findings.recommendation: Coordinate recovery state and retain replayable source beyond refresh interval withmargin.
findings.resolution: Coordinate recovery state and retain replayable source beyond refresh interval withmargin.

findings.title: MERGE error settings do not establish a complete business version policy
findings.evidence: Ambiguousmatched errors differ from duplicate unmatched inserts.
findings.recommendation: Validate sourcegrain,versions,tombstones andties;localCDCworkbook demonstrates explicit businesscontract.
findings.resolution: Validate sourcegrain,versions,tombstones andties;localCDCworkbook demonstrates explicit businesscontract.

findings.title: Filtering consumption does not preserve omitted changes
findings.evidence: Committed DML consumes available changes;plainSELECT/rollback do notadvanceoffset.
findings.recommendation: Require independent consumer offsets and failure/replay evidence.
findings.resolution: Require independent consumer offsets and failure/replay evidence.

findings.title: Target lag is best-effort freshness rather than a timer
findings.evidence: Root-relative goal,min60s,DOWNSTREAM needs an actual refreshconsumer.
findings.recommendation: Add terminal scheduling decision and actual-lag monitoring.
findings.resolution: Add terminal scheduling decision and actual-lag monitoring.
